title: Measuring the Marginal Value of Verifier-Based RL Beyond Supervised Fine-Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2611.07639v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) is usually evaluated as an alternative to supervised fine-tuning (SFT), or as a stage that follows it, with the implicit assumption that the RL stage contributes gains of its own. We measure that contribution directly, in a controlled setting where both stages can be run to completion and compared exactly. We built gpu-train-debug, a deterministic benchmark of 1,877 synthetic GPU and LLM training failure diagnosis tasks across 30 archetypes, graded by a programmatic verifier with partial credit, and calibrated so that a mid-tier model scores in a 0.60 to 0.75 band. A pilot produced a surprise: 1,200 gold demonstrations nearly solved the benchmark (SFT 0.785 on the hard split), while 15 steps of GRPO from the base model did not move it (0.314 vs 0.311 base). translated_title: 衡量基于验证器的强化学习相对于监督微调的边际价值
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.07639v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）通常被评估为监督微调（SFT）的替代方案，或作为其后续阶段，其中隐含的假设是RL阶段本身能贡献额外的增益。我们在一个受控环境中直接测量了这一贡献，在该环境中两个阶段都可以完整运行并进行精确比较。我们构建了gpu-train-debug，这是一个包含1,877个合成GPU和LLM训练失败诊断任务的确定性基准，涵盖30种任务原型，由带部分得分的程序化验证器进行评分，并经过校准使中等层级模型的得分落在0.60至0.75区间内。一项试点实验带来了意外发现：1,200个黄金示范几乎解决了该基准（SFT在困难分割上得分为0.785），而从基础模型开始的15步GRPO训练几乎没有改变结果（0.314，对比基础模型的0.311）。因此，我们在完整实验运行之前以书面形式修改了研究方案，提出了更尖锐的问题：基于验证器的RL在此基础之上究竟有何额外贡献。
tldr: 该论文构建了一个确定性的GPU/LLM训练故障诊断基准，发现仅用1,200个黄金示范的监督微调即可近乎解决该基准，而从基础模型出发的GRPO强化学习几乎无增益，从而质疑了基于验证器的强化学习相对于监督微调的边际价值。
en_tdlr: By building a deterministic benchmark of 1,877 GPU/LLM training failure diagnosis tasks, this paper finds that SFT with 1,200 gold demonstrations nearly solves the benchmark while 15 steps of GRPO from the base model yields virtually no gain, questioning the marginal value of verifier-based RL beyond supervised fine-tuning.
